relationshipSemantics.catalog-link: An explicit title-to-title link authored in titles.json.
relationshipSemantics.reciprocal: Both titles explicitly link to each other.
relationshipSemantics.one-way: Only one title explicitly links to the other. This is preserved, not automatically repaired.
relationshipSemantics.evidence: Computed descriptive signals used to understand why an edge may exist. They are not asserted causal explanations.
